purpose: Generate multiple mechanistically distinct, unranked, pre-registrable follow-up families for the common T052 risk/stability failure pattern.

families.name: volatility_targeted_exposure_overlay
families.mechanism: Scale total strategy exposure from trailing realized volatility while keeping the underlying entry/exit signal unchanged.
families.orthogonality: continuous exposure sizing; does not change signal direction or event interpretation
families.later_preregistration_requirement: Fix lookback, annualization, target volatility, minimum/maximum exposure and rebalance timing before any performance evaluation on the validation universe.

families.name: portfolio_drawdown_state_throttle
families.mechanism: Use a fixed portfolio-drawdown state machine to reduce gross exposure after objectively defined drawdown states and restore exposure only after a fixed recovery condition.
families.orthogonality: state-dependent portfolio exposure; differs from continuous volatility scaling and from signal modification
families.later_preregistration_requirement: Fix drawdown thresholds, exposure multipliers, recovery rule and evaluation timing before any performance evaluation.

families.name: common_mode_correlation_cap
families.mechanism: Reduce gross exposure when cross-asset dependence indicates that nominally separate positions are behaving as a common risk factor.
families.orthogonality: cross-sectional common-mode risk control; does not alter individual security signal ranking
families.later_preregistration_requirement: Fix dependence estimator, lookback, trigger condition, exposure cap and benchmark treatment before any performance evaluation.

families.name: position_lifecycle_tail_control
families.mechanism: Add a fixed lifecycle exit layer to limit the persistence of positions during adverse or stale holding periods without changing the entry signal.
families.orthogonality: trade lifecycle control; distinct from portfolio-level sizing and common-mode exposure control
families.later_preregistration_requirement: Fix maximum holding period, adverse-move rule, measurement convention and exit execution assumption before any performance evaluation.

non_ranking_rule: No family is preferred, scored, ranked or promoted in Q030. The design round creates candidate mechanisms only.
validation_rule: Any future performance trial must use a fresh preregistration, explicit fixed parameters, coverage/PIT validation and the unchanged evidence gates. Holdout observations cannot select families or parameters.
